answer: The sable of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The ember is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the marble. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, diluted when peers disagree, no identity may audit its own recruit.
